title: New Independent Dream Study
content: Hi fellow dreamers. I’m in the beginning stages of a dream study and need to collect some information. I feel like this would be a good place to share a link to a brief survey about your dreams in general. If anyone has an interest in being a participant, it takes nothing more than a few surveys over the next few months. Of course you can reach out for more information or to provide more details if you’d like. Thank you!
